title: Great app, but sad about losing the premium subscription discount
body:
Hi team, the app is awesome, no improvement feedback on my side. 
However, I think commercially-wise it’s not te best that you only offer a reduced price in the first days after installation. In my opinion, it should be given after several days of usage when the person already explores full benefits and is ready to make this commitment. I was pretty frustrated when I didn’t have a chance to get the subscription at the reduced rate exactly in the moment when I decided app was valuable enough for me to do the purchase. Exactly in that moment the price has increased for me, and I ended up not subscribing, feeling like I “lost my chance” already. Maybe you can do an A/B test with newly acquired users, offering a temporary discount in the first vs second week of usage to check which results in a higher engagement and subscription rate. And you can also give the discount to me again :) 
Thanks and all the best
